name: Storm of Needles
body:
School conjuration (creation) [metal]; Level magus 4, sorcerer/wizard 4

Casting Time 1 standard action

Components V, S, M (a small needle)

Range 30 feet

Area cone-shaped emanation

Duration instantaneous

Saving Throw Reflex half; Spell Resistance no

Metal: Spells with this descriptor include those that directly create, utilize, or manipulate metal in some manner or conjure creatures composed of metal. Such spells are considered to belong to the Metal element (for geomancers) and the metal elemental school (for metal elementalists).

You unleash a spray of small metal needles in a 30-foot cone. Each creature in the area must make a Reflex save or take 1d4 piercing damage per caster level (maximum 15d4). A successful Reflex save halves this damage.
